product_wide_rationale: Defines the Product-wide boundary that removes an execution identity only after preservation and reconciliation, so no Domain can retain an actionable shelved or cancelled execution.
summary: Shelving and cancellation use a typed, fenced, replay-safe removal operation that preserves the planning handoff and exact event history, removes owned execution projections, keeps Linear issues open, and gives renewed work a fresh identity. Liveness remains read-time evidence and never authorizes removal.
title: Operator-directed execution removal preserves the planning record
